mapper.update: CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE tmp_dppms_contract_completion_scope (tenant_id BIGINT NOT NULL,kind VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,target_id BIGINT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(tenant_id,kind,target_id))
CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE tmp_dppms_review_unique_company (tenant_id BIGINT NOT NULL,code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,org_id BIGINT NOT NULL,name VARCHAR(255),PRIMARY KEY(tenant_id,code))
CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE tmp_dppms_review_unique_department (tenant_id BIGINT NOT NULL,code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,org_id BIGINT NOT NULL,name VARCHAR(255),PRIMARY KEY(tenant_id,code))

CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE tmp_dppms_review_unique_contract AS SELECT tenant_id,contract_no,MIN(id) AS contract_id,MIN(company_code) AS company_code FROM com_contract WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND deleted=0 GROUP BY tenant_id,contract_no HAVING COUNT(*)=1
mapper.select: SELECT c.id FROM com_contract c JOIN tmp_dppms_contract_completion_scope b ON b.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND b.target_id=c.id AND b.kind='CONTRACT' WHERE c.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND c.deleted=0 AND c.master_source_system='DPPMS_ERP' ORDER BY c.id FOR UPDATE

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tmp_dppms_contract_completion_scope b WHERE b.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND ( (b.kind='CONTRACT' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM com_contract c WHERE c.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND c.id=b.target_id AND c.deleted=0 AND c.master_source_system='DPPMS_ERP')) OR (b.kind IN ('SHIPMENT','CURRENT_SHIPMENT') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM com_shipment_contract_reference s WHERE s.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND s.id=b.target_id AND s.deleted=0 AND s.source_system='DPPMS')) OR (b.kind='PACKAGE' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM com_shipment_package p WHERE p.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND p.id=b.target_id AND p.deleted=0 AND p.source_system='DPPMS')) OR (b.kind='RECEIVABLE' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM com_contract_receivable r WHERE r.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND r.id=b.target_id AND r.deleted=0 AND r.source_system='DPPMS')))

SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(c.contract_no,s.contract_no,parent.contract_no) FROM tmp_dppms_contract_completion_scope b LEFT JOIN com_contract c ON b.kind='CONTRACT' AND c.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND c.id=b.target_id AND c.deleted=0 AND c.master_source_system='DPPMS_ERP' LEFT JOIN com_shipment_contract_reference s ON b.kind='CURRENT_SHIPMENT' AND s.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND s.id=b.target_id AND s.deleted=0 AND s.source_system='DPPMS' LEFT JOIN com_shipment_package p ON b.kind='PACKAGE' AND p.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND p.id=b.target_id AND p.deleted=0 AND p.source_system='DPPMS' LEFT JOIN com_shipment_contract_reference parent ON parent.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND parent.source_system=p.source_system AND parent.source_record_key=p.shipment_contract_source_key AND parent.deleted=0 WHERE b.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND b.kind IN ('CONTRACT','CURRENT_SHIPMENT','PACKAGE')

SELECT t.contract_no FROM com_contract t JOIN tmp_dppms_contract_completion_scope b ON b.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND b.target_id=t.id AND b.kind='CONTRACT' JOIN tmp_dppms_review_unique_company c ON c.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND c.code=t.company_code WHERE t.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND t.deleted=0 AND t.master_source_system='DPPMS_ERP' AND (NOT(t.company_id <=> c.org_id) OR NOT(t.company_name <=> c.name))

SELECT c.contract_no FROM com_contract c JOIN tmp_dppms_contract_completion_scope b ON b.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND b.target_id=c.id AND b.kind='CONTRACT' JOIN tmp_dppms_review_unique_contract u ON u.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND u.contract_id=c.id LEFT JOIN tmp_dppms_contract_shipment_fields s ON s.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND s.contract_no=c.contract_no LEFT JOIN tmp_dppms_contract_receivable_fields r ON r.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND r.contract_no=c.contract_no WHERE c.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND c.deleted=b'0' AND c.master_source_system='DPPMS_ERP' AND (NOT(c.currency_name <=> COALESCE(r.currency_name,c.currency_name)) OR NOT(c.currency_code <=> COALESCE(r.currency_name,c.currency_code)) OR NOT(c.contract_amount <=> COALESCE(r.contract_amount,c.contract_amount)) OR NOT(c.contract_create_time <=> COALESCE(r.contract_create_time,c.contract_create_time)) OR NOT(c.project_name <=> COALESCE(s.project_name,r.project_name,c.project_name)) OR NOT(c.project_code <=> COALESCE(r.project_code,c.project_code)) OR NOT(c.market_code <=> COALESCE(s.market_code,r.market_code,c.market_code)) OR NOT(c.market_name <=> COALESCE(s.market_name,r.market_name,c.market_name)) OR NOT(c.department_code <=> COALESCE(s.department_code,r.department_code,c.department_code)) OR NOT(c.department_name <=> COALESCE(r.department_name,c.department_name)) OR NOT(c.industry_code <=> COALESCE(r.industry_code,c.industry_code)) OR NOT(c.industry_name <=> COALESCE(r.industry_name,c.industry_name)) OR NOT(c.marketing_representative_code <=> COALESCE(r.marketing_representative_code,c.marketing_representative_code)) OR NOT(c.marketing_representative_name <=> COALESCE(r.marketing_representative_name,c.marketing_representative_name)) OR NOT(c.secondary_representative_code <=> COALESCE(r.secondary_representative_code,c.secondary_representative_code)) OR NOT(c.system_name <=> COALESCE(s.system_name,c.system_name)))

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM com_shipment_contract_reference s JOIN tmp_dppms_contract_completion_scope b ON b.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND b.target_id=s.id AND b.kind='CURRENT_SHIPMENT' LEFT JOIN tmp_dppms_review_unique_contract c ON c.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND c.contract_no=s.contract_no LEFT JOIN tmp_dppms_review_unique_company co ON co.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND co.code=c.company_code LEFT JOIN tmp_dppms_review_unique_department d ON d.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND d.code=s.department_code WHERE s.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND s.deleted=0 AND s.source_system='DPPMS' AND (NOT(s.contract_id <=> COALESCE(c.contract_id,s.contract_id)) OR NOT(s.company_code <=> COALESCE(c.company_code,s.company_code)) OR NOT(s.company_id <=> COALESCE(co.org_id,s.company_id)) OR (co.org_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT(s.company_name <=> co.name)) OR NOT(s.department_id <=> COALESCE(d.org_id,s.department_id)) OR (d.org_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT(s.department_name <=> d.name)))

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM com_shipment_package p JOIN tmp_dppms_contract_completion_scope b ON b.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND b.target_id=p.id AND b.kind='PACKAGE' JOIN com_shipment_contract_reference c ON c.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND c.source_system=p.source_system AND c.source_record_key=p.shipment_contract_source_key AND c.deleted=0 WHERE p.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND p.deleted=0 AND p.source_system='DPPMS' AND NOT(p.shipment_contract_ref_id <=> c.id)
mapper.update: UPDATE com_contract t JOIN tmp_dppms_contract_completion_scope b ON b.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND b.target_id=t.id AND b.kind='CONTRACT' JOIN tmp_dppms_review_unique_company c ON c.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND c.code=t.company_code SET t.company_id=c.org_id,t.company_name=c.name,t.version=t.version+1 WHERE t.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND t.deleted=0 AND t.master_source_system='DPPMS_ERP' AND (NOT(t.company_id <=> c.org_id) OR NOT(t.company_name <=> c.name))

UPDATE com_shipment_contract_reference s JOIN tmp_dppms_contract_completion_scope b ON b.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND b.target_id=s.id AND b.kind='CURRENT_SHIPMENT' LEFT JOIN tmp_dppms_review_unique_contract c ON c.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND c.contract_no=s.contract_no LEFT JOIN tmp_dppms_review_unique_company co ON co.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND co.code=c.company_code LEFT JOIN tmp_dppms_review_unique_department d ON d.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND d.code=s.department_code SET s.contract_id=COALESCE(c.contract_id,s.contract_id), s.company_code=COALESCE(c.company_code,s.company_code),s.company_id=COALESCE(co.org_id,s.company_id), s.company_name=CASE WHEN co.org_id IS NOT NULL THEN co.name ELSE s.company_name END, s.department_id=COALESCE(d.org_id,s.department_id), s.department_name=CASE WHEN d.org_id IS NOT NULL THEN d.name ELSE s.department_name END WHERE s.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND s.deleted=0 AND s.source_system='DPPMS' AND (NOT(s.contract_id <=> COALESCE(c.contract_id,s.contract_id)) OR NOT(s.company_code <=> COALESCE(c.company_code,s.company_code)) OR NOT(s.company_id <=> COALESCE(co.org_id,s.company_id)) OR (co.org_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT(s.company_name <=> co.name)) OR NOT(s.department_id <=> COALESCE(d.org_id,s.department_id)) OR (d.org_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT(s.department_name <=> d.name)))

UPDATE com_shipment_package p JOIN tmp_dppms_contract_completion_scope b ON b.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND b.target_id=p.id AND b.kind='PACKAGE' JOIN com_shipment_contract_reference c ON c.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND c.source_system=p.source_system AND c.source_record_key=p.shipment_contract_source_key AND c.deleted=0 SET p.shipment_contract_ref_id=c.id WHERE p.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND p.deleted=0 AND p.source_system='DPPMS' AND NOT(p.shipment_contract_ref_id <=> c.id)

CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE tmp_dppms_contract_shipment_fields AS SELECT s.tenant_id,s.contract_no, SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`project_name` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`project_name` AS CHAR)<>'' THEN CONCAT(RPAD(s.source_record_key,64,' '),CAST(s.`project_name` AS CHAR)) END),65) AS `project_name`, SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`market_code` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`market_code` AS CHAR)<>'' THEN CONCAT(RPAD(s.source_record_key,64,' '),CAST(s.`market_code` AS CHAR)) END),65) AS `market_code`, SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`market_name` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`market_name` AS CHAR)<>'' THEN CONCAT(RPAD(s.source_record_key,64,' '),CAST(s.`market_name` AS CHAR)) END),65) AS `market_name`, SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`department_code` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`department_code` AS CHAR)<>'' THEN CONCAT(RPAD(s.source_record_key,64,' '),CAST(s.`department_code` AS CHAR)) END),65) AS `department_code`, SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`system_name` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`system_name` AS CHAR)<>'' THEN CONCAT(RPAD(s.source_record_key,64,' '),CAST(s.`system_name` AS CHAR)) END),65) AS `system_name` FROM com_shipment_contract_reference s JOIN tmp_dppms_contract_completion_scope b ON b.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND b.target_id=s.id AND b.kind='SHIPMENT' WHERE s.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND s.deleted=b'0' AND s.source_system='DPPMS' GROUP BY s.tenant_id,s.contract_no

CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE tmp_dppms_contract_receivable_fields AS SELECT s.tenant_id,s.contract_no, SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`currency_name` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`currency_name` AS CHAR)<>'' THEN CONCAT(CONCAT(COALESCE(LEFT(CAST(s.source_sync_time AS CHAR),19),'1000-01-01 00:00:00'),LPAD(s.source_record_key,20,'0')),CAST(s.`currency_name` AS CHAR)) END),40) AS `currency_name`, SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`contract_amount` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`contract_amount` AS CHAR)<>'' THEN CONCAT(CONCAT(COALESCE(LEFT(CAST(s.source_sync_time AS CHAR),19),'1000-01-01 00:00:00'),LPAD(s.source_record_key,20,'0')),CAST(s.`contract_amount` AS CHAR)) END),40) AS `contract_amount`, SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`contract_create_time` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`contract_create_time` AS CHAR)<>'' THEN CONCAT(CONCAT(COALESCE(LEFT(CAST(s.source_sync_time AS CHAR),19),'1000-01-01 00:00:00'),LPAD(s.source_record_key,20,'0')),CAST(s.`contract_create_time` AS CHAR)) END),40) AS `contract_create_time`, SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`project_name` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`project_name` AS CHAR)<>'' THEN CONCAT(CONCAT(COALESCE(LEFT(CAST(s.source_sync_time AS CHAR),19),'1000-01-01 00:00:00'),LPAD(s.source_record_key,20,'0')),CAST(s.`project_name` AS CHAR)) END),40) AS `project_name`, SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`project_code` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`project_code` AS CHAR)<>'' THEN CONCAT(CONCAT(COALESCE(LEFT(CAST(s.source_sync_time AS CHAR),19),'1000-01-01 00:00:00'),LPAD(s.source_record_key,20,'0')),CAST(s.`project_code` AS CHAR)) END),40) AS `project_code`, SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`market_code` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`market_code` AS CHAR)<>'' THEN CONCAT(CONCAT(COALESCE(LEFT(CAST(s.source_sync_time AS CHAR),19),'1000-01-01 00:00:00'),LPAD(s.source_record_key,20,'0')),CAST(s.`market_code` AS CHAR)) END),40) AS `market_code`, SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`market_name` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`market_name` AS CHAR)<>'' THEN CONCAT(CONCAT(COALESCE(LEFT(CAST(s.source_sync_time AS CHAR),19),'1000-01-01 00:00:00'),LPAD(s.source_record_key,20,'0')),CAST(s.`market_name` AS CHAR)) END),40) AS `market_name`, SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`department_code` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`department_code` AS CHAR)<>'' THEN CONCAT(CONCAT(COALESCE(LEFT(CAST(s.source_sync_time AS CHAR),19),'1000-01-01 00:00:00'),LPAD(s.source_record_key,20,'0')),CAST(s.`department_code` AS CHAR)) END),40) AS `department_code`, SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`department_name` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`department_name` AS CHAR)<>'' THEN CONCAT(CONCAT(COALESCE(LEFT(CAST(s.source_sync_time AS CHAR),19),'1000-01-01 00:00:00'),LPAD(s.source_record_key,20,'0')),CAST(s.`department_name` AS CHAR)) END),40) AS `department_name`, SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`industry_code` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`industry_code` AS CHAR)<>'' THEN CONCAT(CONCAT(COALESCE(LEFT(CAST(s.source_sync_time AS CHAR),19),'1000-01-01 00:00:00'),LPAD(s.source_record_key,20,'0')),CAST(s.`industry_code` AS CHAR)) END),40) AS `industry_code`, SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`industry_name` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`industry_name` AS CHAR)<>'' THEN CONCAT(CONCAT(COALESCE(LEFT(CAST(s.source_sync_time AS CHAR),19),'1000-01-01 00:00:00'),LPAD(s.source_record_key,20,'0')),CAST(s.`industry_name` AS CHAR)) END),40) AS `industry_name`, SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`marketing_representative_code` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`marketing_representative_code` AS CHAR)<>'' THEN CONCAT(CONCAT(COALESCE(LEFT(CAST(s.source_sync_time AS CHAR),19),'1000-01-01 00:00:00'),LPAD(s.source_record_key,20,'0')),CAST(s.`marketing_representative_code` AS CHAR)) END),40) AS `marketing_representative_code`, SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`marketing_representative_name` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`marketing_representative_name` AS CHAR)<>'' THEN CONCAT(CONCAT(COALESCE(LEFT(CAST(s.source_sync_time AS CHAR),19),'1000-01-01 00:00:00'),LPAD(s.source_record_key,20,'0')),CAST(s.`marketing_representative_name` AS CHAR)) END),40) AS `marketing_representative_name`, SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`secondary_representative_code` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`secondary_representative_code` AS CHAR)<>'' THEN CONCAT(CONCAT(COALESCE(LEFT(CAST(s.source_sync_time AS CHAR),19),'1000-01-01 00:00:00'),LPAD(s.source_record_key,20,'0')),CAST(s.`secondary_representative_code` AS CHAR)) END),40) AS `secondary_representative_code` FROM com_contract_receivable s JOIN tmp_dppms_contract_completion_scope b ON b.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND b.target_id=s.id AND b.kind='RECEIVABLE' WHERE s.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND s.deleted=b'0' AND s.source_system='DPPMS' GROUP BY s.tenant_id,s.contract_no

UPDATE com_contract c JOIN tmp_dppms_contract_completion_scope b ON b.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND b.target_id=c.id AND b.kind='CONTRACT' JOIN tmp_dppms_review_unique_contract u ON u.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND u.contract_id=c.id LEFT JOIN tmp_dppms_contract_shipment_fields s ON s.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND s.contract_no=c.contract_no LEFT JOIN tmp_dppms_contract_receivable_fields r ON r.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND r.contract_no=c.contract_no SET c.currency_name=COALESCE(r.currency_name,c.currency_name), c.currency_code=COALESCE(r.currency_name,c.currency_code), c.contract_amount=COALESCE(r.contract_amount,c.contract_amount), c.contract_create_time=COALESCE(r.contract_create_time,c.contract_create_time), c.project_name=COALESCE(s.project_name,r.project_name,c.project_name), c.project_code=COALESCE(r.project_code,c.project_code), c.market_code=COALESCE(s.market_code,r.market_code,c.market_code), c.market_name=COALESCE(s.market_name,r.market_name,c.market_name), c.department_code=COALESCE(s.department_code,r.department_code,c.department_code), c.department_name=COALESCE(r.department_name,c.department_name), c.industry_code=COALESCE(r.industry_code,c.industry_code), c.industry_name=COALESCE(r.industry_name,c.industry_name), c.marketing_representative_code=COALESCE(r.marketing_representative_code,c.marketing_representative_code), c.marketing_representative_name=COALESCE(r.marketing_representative_name,c.marketing_representative_name), c.secondary_representative_code=COALESCE(r.secondary_representative_code,c.secondary_representative_code), c.system_name=COALESCE(s.system_name,c.system_name),c.version=c.version+1 WHERE c.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND c.deleted=b'0' AND c.master_source_system='DPPMS_ERP' AND (NOT(c.currency_name <=> COALESCE(r.currency_name,c.currency_name)) OR NOT(c.currency_code <=> COALESCE(r.currency_name,c.currency_code)) OR NOT(c.contract_amount <=> COALESCE(r.contract_amount,c.contract_amount)) OR NOT(c.contract_create_time <=> COALESCE(r.contract_create_time,c.contract_create_time)) OR NOT(c.project_name <=> COALESCE(s.project_name,r.project_name,c.project_name)) OR NOT(c.project_code <=> COALESCE(r.project_code,c.project_code)) OR NOT(c.market_code <=> COALESCE(s.market_code,r.market_code,c.market_code)) OR NOT(c.market_name <=> COALESCE(s.market_name,r.market_name,c.market_name)) OR NOT(c.department_code <=> COALESCE(s.department_code,r.department_code,c.department_code)) OR NOT(c.department_name <=> COALESCE(r.department_name,c.department_name)) OR NOT(c.industry_code <=> COALESCE(r.industry_code,c.industry_code)) OR NOT(c.industry_name <=> COALESCE(r.industry_name,c.industry_name)) OR NOT(c.marketing_representative_code <=> COALESCE(r.marketing_representative_code,c.marketing_representative_code)) OR NOT(c.marketing_representative_name <=> COALESCE(r.marketing_representative_name,c.marketing_representative_name)) OR NOT(c.secondary_representative_code <=> COALESCE(r.secondary_representative_code,c.secondary_representative_code)) OR NOT(c.system_name <=> COALESCE(s.system_name,c.system_name)))

choose.when: SELECT id,company_id AS companyId,company_code AS companyCode,company_name AS companyName, department_code AS departmentCode,department_name AS departmentName,version, currency_name AS currencyName,currency_code AS currencyCode,contract_amount AS contractAmount,contract_create_time AS contractCreateTime, project_name AS projectName,project_code AS projectCode,market_code AS marketCode,market_name AS marketName, industry_code AS industryCode,industry_name AS industryName,marketing_representative_code AS marketingRepresentativeCode, marketing_representative_name AS marketingRepresentativeName,secondary_representative_code AS secondaryRepresentativeCode,system_name AS systemName FROM com_contract WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND deleted=0 AND master_source_system='DPPMS_ERP'

SELECT id,company_id AS companyId,company_code AS companyCode,company_name AS companyName,contract_id AS contractId, department_id AS departmentId,department_code AS departmentCode,department_name AS departmentName FROM com_shipment_contract_reference WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND deleted=0 AND source_system='DPPMS'
choose.otherwise: SELECT id,shipment_contract_ref_id AS shipmentContractReferenceId FROM com_shipment_package WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND deleted=0 AND source_system='DPPMS'
